# Shared parity corpus: one raw shell command per line.
# scripts/oracle.zsh runs each through the reference zsh hook to produce the
# ground-truth verdict; tests/parity.rs asserts the binary agrees.
# Lines that are blank or start with '#' are skipped by both.

# --- expected BLOCK: rg with a bare -r (or -r* cluster) as its own argument ---
rg -r foo
rg -n -r pat path
cat x | rg -r bar
time rg -r x
sudo rg -r x
doas rg -r x
nice rg -r x
env X=1 rg -r x
command rg -r x
X=1 rg -r x
/usr/bin/rg -r x
rg -rn foo
rg -r=x p
rg -rfoo
rg foo -r
rg --foo -r x
rg foo && rg -r bar
cat a | rg -r b | wc -l
xargs rg -r x
rg -- foo; rg -r x
for f in a; do rg -r x; done
if true; then rg -r x; fi
X=1 Y=2 rg -r x
(rg -r x)
time (rg -r x)
rg -r x > out

# --- expected ALLOW: -r owned by another command, quoted, --, or not rg ---
rg foo | sort -r
rg foo | xargs rm -r
rg 'a -r b'
rg "a -r b"
rg '-r' x
rg "-r" x
grep -r foo
git grep -r foo
rg --replace=x p
rg --replace x
rg -- -r
rg -R foo
rg foo
rg foo; rm -r d
rg foo && rm -r d
rg $(grep -r x) y
rg `grep -r x` y
myrg -r x
rgx -r foo
1x=1 rg -r x
a-b=1 rg -r x
foo (rg -r x)
sudo (rg -r x)
rg foo (bar)
rg foo > out
rg \-r x
sort -r file
ls -la
echo rg -r foo
